body:
Greg's team direction, 2026-11-02 at about 23:30Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (588693a8 #19) via Termal::Fable2 #3932, verbatim: „OK. Przekaz zespołowi że celem jest praca autonomiczna. Chyba widac po zmianach jakie robimy."
Fable2's operating rules:
- Decide within existing authority without asking Greg or Fable2 for routine calls.
- Bring Fable2 only real decisions, with a concrete plan and a recommendation.
- NEVER route Greg to another session to re-type consent. (Related: Greg via Asistant #4, „Nie bede szukaj jego sesji. Naprawde nie mam czasu na cerominiały.")
The hard limits in CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md stay until amended. The relayed-word rule change is w-e695378f6405, which Fable2 drafts.
